title: Lovely Molten Mexican Sultanas Birria
description: A vegan-friendly Mexican dish featuring sultanas in a molten, yeasty birria sauce, perfect for crowds. This recipe is a unique and delicious twist on traditional birria.
instructions: Roast the guajillo chilies in a 350 degree oven for 5 minutes to enhance their flavor.
Soak the roasted chilies in hot water for 20 minutes to rehydrate them.
Drain and chop the rehydrated chilies, then mortar-pestle-pound them into a smooth paste.
Heat the oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat, then saute the onion and garlic until softened.
Add the chili paste, tomato paste, and yeast to the pot, stirring to combine.
Add the beer, sultanas, and 2 cups of water to the pot, bringing the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the birria sauce for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20 seconds.
Assemble the birria by dipping the tortillas in the molten sauce and serving with lime wedges and cilantro.
Serve the birria immediately, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
